name: m41b_oger_width
question: Does the +2.78pp width gain reproduce on a DIFFERENT deck lineage? Arm and control are both fine-tuned from m41_ogerpon on the same re-encoded ogerpon rows for the same epochs, differing only in whether the 43 appended columns exist. This is the direct test of Part I's deck-agnostic claim: if the gain is a property of the ENCODER it should appear here too; if it was a property of the alakazam lineage it should not.
